lq.q: \(​​​​​​​\text{Classify the PDE: } (1 - x^2)u_{xx} - 2xy u_{xy} + (1 - y^2)u_{yy} + x u_x + 3x^2y u_y - 2u = 0.\) \(\text{Determine regions in the xy-plane where it is elliptic, parabolic, or hyperbolic.}\)
answer: Step Marks Identify coefficients: \( A = 1-x^2, B = -2xy, C = 1-y^2.\) (1 Mark) Compute discriminant: \(\text{\(\Delta = B^2 - 4AC = 4x^2y^2 - 4(1-x^2)(1-y^2)\)}\) . (2 Marks) Simplify: \(\Delta = 4[x^2y^2 - (1 - x^2 - y^2 + x^2y^2)] = 4(x^2 + y^2 - 1)\) . (3 Marks) Parabolic if \( \Delta=0\Rightarrow x^2 + y^2 = 1 \) (circle of radius 1). (2 Marks) Elliptic if \(\Delta<0 \Rightarrow x^2 + y^2 < 1\) (inside the circle). (2 Marks) Hyperbolic if \( \Delta>0 \Rightarrow x^2 + y^2 > 1\) (outside the circle). (2 Marks) Discuss boundary: on circle parabolic, inside elliptic, outside hyperbolic. (2 Marks) Conclusion with region description. (1 Mark)
